leads.summary: HumanLayer sells a multiplayer coding-agent IDE and cloud workspace where teams run background agents and review their sessions, plan artifacts and code diffs in one place.
leads.hook: your homepage says a local daemon runs many agent sessions in parallel on a laptop and syncs through your API, so agents keep working after the laptop closes.
leads.angle_reason: Canopy maps a repo's call graph and architecture, the code-understanding layer a team needs to review large agent-written diffs in a shared workspace like HumanLayer's.

leads.summary: Paragon AI records sales calls and turns them into call notes, Q&A, follow-up emails and filled CRM fields for Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive and Zoho.
leads.hook: your site says every custom CRM field, such as budget and decision maker, is filled automatically from the call transcript.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault's Gemini pipeline turns free-form lab report text into a fixed JSON schema with a fallback parser, the same extraction problem as pulling CRM fields out of a call.

leads.summary: SilkChart analyzes sales calls to measure how well reps follow a playbook such as MEDDIC or SPIN, and surfaces coaching for reps and managers from the results.
leads.hook: your AI Coach shows each rep a 'what you could have said' rephrasing right after the call, scored against the playbook.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault's LLM pipeline with a fixed output schema and safety rules is the closest match to scoring call transcripts against a playbook and returning structured feedback.

leads.summary: Rubbrband is a creative company that makes commercials for large brands and describes itself as a new kind of creative company; its homepage is a portfolio reel of brand video.

leads.angle_reason: The posting tags the company as AI, and MedVault's LLM pipeline is the nearest project to generative AI work, though the overlap with commercial video production is thin.

leads.summary: Cargo is go-to-market infrastructure for coding agents: a git repo defines a company's GTM system as TypeScript, and the Cargo runtime deploys and runs it on triggers or schedules.
leads.hook: your CLI says 'cargo-ai project deploy' plans the diff before it runs and can roll back to any previous state.
leads.angle_reason: Cargo keeps the system as a git repo that agents write to and Cargo deploys, the same code-first, git-aware infrastructure Canopy works in (commit-hash caching, git ls-remote before cloning).

leads.summary: Syncly is an AI social listening and creator discovery platform for consumer brands, with video analysis across TikTok, Reels and Shorts and a customer feedback product.
leads.hook: your Syncly MCP connector brings social listening into Claude and ChatGPT through a remote MCP server.
leads.angle_reason: Syncly's Ask Syncly feature answers plain-language questions with cited source videos, the grounded-LLM-over-structured-data pattern MedVault implements.

leads.summary: Glass Health builds clinical AI for clinicians, offering differential diagnosis support, ambient scribing and care planning, grounded in peer-reviewed evidence.
leads.hook: your homepage announces 'New Glass for Patients is now available', a patient-facing product alongside the clinician tools.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault is a health-data LLM product with a fixed JSON output schema and safety rules that forbid diagnosis or prescription, a comparable constraint set to a clinical AI product.

leads.summary: Magic Patterns is an AI design tool where product teams prototype UI from prompts, PRDs and repos, then hand the result to a coding agent or deploy it to a site.
leads.hook: your 'Design System' feature asks teams to bring in their components and design rules so every generated concept comes out in their style.
leads.angle_reason: Magic Patterns takes a team's repo as generation context, and Canopy turns a repo into an architecture map, the code-understanding side of that same input.

leads.summary: Narrative, now rebranded as Zorro, sells AI regression tests written in plain English that self-heal, plus AI bug bashes that explore an app to find bugs, as an alternative to Playwright, Selenium and Cypress scripts.
leads.hook: your demo shows autohealing matching a renamed 'Add employee' button to 'New employee' and flagging the rename as a potential bug.
leads.angle_reason: Zorro runs regression tests on pull requests, and Canopy computes which functions and call paths a change touches, the input a PR-triggered test selector needs.

leads.summary: Cogram sells AI tools for architecture and engineering firms, covering RFIs and submittals, email filing, meeting minutes, field reports and a project Q&A agent, integrated with Procore and Microsoft Teams.
